2027-05-01.title: God Showed Us The Path to Blessing Long Ago
2027-05-01.verse: And now, if you will diligently listen to me and keep my covenant, then you will be my special possession out of all the nations, for all the earth is mine, and you will be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words that you will speak to the Israelites.
2027-05-01.observation: When my girls were little, they would often be given a list of chores to do over the course of a week. They were told that if they would do the chores, they would be “blessed” with going out to eat on the weekend and a trip to the ice cream shop. Many times, this would not go as expected. One of my girls would not fulfill her responsibilities and then not understand why they couldn’t go while the other could. Over and over I would explain that the path to “blessing” was simple obedience. It was hard to not get frustrated because it seemed so simple. If you do what you are told, you receive a blessing. In my mind, this should have made the act of obedience simple. However, it is not so simple. I cannot count how many times I have done this to the Lord. I wonder why I don’t experience His blessings in my life only to realize I have done the same things as my girls. How many times do we not do what the Lord says but expect His blessings anyway? For me, too many times to count.
2027-05-01.application: Is there any area of your life where you need to walk in more obedience?
2027-05-01.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for Your endless patience.

2027-05-02.title: Start With Relationship
2027-05-02.verse: I, the Lord, am your God, who brought you from the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery.
2027-05-02.observation: God is about to lay out the “rules of freedom.” He is going to help these multi-generational slaves learn how to stay in freedom. Before He shares a single command, He reminds them who is giving the commands. He is the God who loves them so much that He rescued them from slavery. Therefore, everything He tells them to do comes from that foundation. When we read God’s Word, it is possible to sometimes think God is trying to take the fun out of life. It seems all the things we want to do are found in the sections that warn us to stay away. However, when we remember who God is and how much He loves us, we realize there must always be a reason for why He says what He says. You can trust God because of what He has already done.
2027-05-02.application: Where do you need to trust God today?
2027-05-02.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us more than we will ever realize.

2027-05-03.title: God Requires Radical Kindness
2027-05-03.verse: If you buy a Hebrew servant, he is to serve you for six years, but in the seventh year he will go out free without paying anything.
2027-05-03.observation: During that time, it would have been unexpected to hear such a law. When someone was in a financial place that they needed to go work for someone else, they would not always have an end date to their servitude. However, the Israelites were to set Hebrew servants free in the seventh year. Later when continuing these themes, God says they are to remember a time when they were slaves back in Egypt. This is to remind them of their past so they will show mercy in the present. When God saves us, we are never to forget His kindness. This is to remind us to be kind to others. We never need to get to the place that we look down on others who are currently experiencing what we used to be bound by in our own lives. Instead, we show kindness where possible. We do so because we remember the kindness that we needed. Now we are in a position to bless someone else.
2027-05-03.application: Is there someone you need to show mercy to today? If so, remember to always do so within healthy boundaries.
2027-05-03.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for showing us kindness and now giving us the chance to show kindness toward others.

2027-05-04.title: Remove All Rebellious Evil
2027-05-04.verse: You must not allow a sorceress to live.
2027-05-04.observation: For some reason, I once read this and thought of someone being surprised. It is almost like watching a scene from a movie. There is someone minding their own business and the police come out of nowhere and arrest them for a crime they did not realize was illegal. Then, the police tell them ignorance is not an excuse. If we were watching a movie with this scene, we could easily have compassion for this person. But, imagine watching a movie where someone knew something was wrong and knew the penalty was death. When the guilty person was caught, we would realize they knew the consequences and the reason why the penalty was so high. Justice has been earned. This is more like what is going on in this verse. God tells Moses to warn the people that witchcraft would not be tolerated. Therefore, if someone decides they are going to be rebellious and do it anyway, the consequences have been spelled out clearly. We must be careful with attitudes like this in our own lives. God’s Word specifically says to stay away from certain things for good reasons. He also spells out what sin does to us in destroying our relationships, our lives, and more. If we choose to be rebellious and sin anyway, justice has been earned.
2027-05-04.application: Is there anything you know offends the heart of God that you are holding onto? Is it time to let it go?
2027-05-04.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for Your endless mercy.

2027-05-05.title: Kindness Because it is the Right Thing to Do
2027-05-05.verse: If you see the donkey of someone who hates you fallen under its load, you must not ignore him, but be sure to help him with it.
2027-05-05.observation: Today’s passage is a good example of how the character that God builds in us must be taken from His Word. It cannot be built by looking at the world or looking inside ourselves to find “another truth.” In today’s passage, it seems to command us to do exactly the opposite of what we may think is the right move. If we see someone we hate experiencing trouble, how many times do we think they are getting what they deserve? We may even say God is honoring us by judging them. However, the Lord tells us to help our enemy when they are in distress. Notice, it is not saying they stop being our enemy. We are doing the right thing because it is the right thing to do. By showing kindness, while not excusing their faults, we are creating space for possible forgiveness. Showing kindness may be the only way for them to see what the love of God looks like. They may say, “I know how much they dislike me. Only someone who has been touched by the love of God would ever do what they have done.”
2027-05-05.application: How will you posture yourself to be ready to show kindness, within healthy boundaries, to someone today?
2027-05-05.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us first and giving us the capacity to love others.

2027-05-06.title: Fellowship With God
2027-05-06.verse: and they saw the God of Israel. Under his feet there was something like a pavement made of sapphire, clear like the sky itself. But he did not lay a hand on the leaders of the Israelites, so they saw God, and they ate and they drank.
2027-05-06.observation: When I was a kid, our church would have “fellowship meals.” Fellowship meant a set aside time when the goal was to spend time together. At these meals, everyone would bring food to share. We would pray over the food and then dig in. We would sit around, eat, and talk without any agenda. The goal was to simply be together. These moments reminded us that there was more than agendas, schedules, meetings, and all the other things that keep our lives spinning. In today’s passage, we see a time when God has created the same space. The goal of this very special occasion was to simply be with the Lord. Many have wondered exactly how this happened. Could this be a rare Christophany in the Old Testament? We are unsure. What we do know is that in the midst of all that was going on, the Lord paused it all to have a time of fellowship with His people. In all our busyness, may we never forget to pause and have times of fellowship with the Lord.
2027-05-06.application: What would it look like if you took one of your meals today and had “fellowship” with the Lord? Here’s how: stay away from technology and spend time reflecting on the goodness of God while you eat. Watch what happens.
2027-05-06.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for wanting to know and be known by us.

2027-05-07.title: Make A Place to Meet With the LORD
2027-05-07.verse: You are to put the atonement lid on top of the ark, and in the ark you are to put the testimony I am giving you. I will meet with you there, and from above the atonement lid, from between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the testimony, I will speak with you about all that I will command you for the Israelites.
2027-05-07.observation: The Tabernacle was meant to be portable. They were instructed to carry the presence of God with them wherever they went. However, within that structure, there were places for things to sit. The most important was the Ark of the Covenant. The Ark was a representation of the presence of God. They honored the Ark because it represented the Throne of their Heavenly King. When we meet with God, we are not bound by a place and time. We carry the presence of God with us wherever we go. However, we must never forget the wonder and honor of being able to meet with the King of kings wherever we go. We must always create an attitude of honor so that, wherever we meet with the Lord, we make a place in our heart that honors the moment and treats the Lord as holy.
2027-05-07.application: This week, during your quiet time with the LORD, remember the honor we have of meeting with the King. Set aside the time as an uninterrupted time of fellowship with the LORD.
2027-05-07.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for allowing us to know You.

2027-05-08.title: Make Your Worship Portable
2027-05-08.verse: You are to make a hanging for the entrance of the tent of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen, the work of an embroiderer. You are to make for the hanging five posts of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, and their hooks will be gold, and you are to cast five bronze bases for them.
2027-05-08.observation: In today’s chapter, we see Moses receiving instructions on how to create a “house of worship” that could go with them throughout their wandering in the wilderness. No matter where they went, the LORD was going to go with them. They were never to go anywhere without the LORD and they were not to create a space so “set in stone” that they could not carry it to the next place. This is a great reminder to us about settling in our hearts that we will carry the presence of the LORD with us wherever we go. Too many times we associate worship with our local church. When we think of worshiping God, we think it is only right to worship there. We also have a special place where we do our devotions at home and only think we can do devotions there. The problem is that we will skip our times with God while on vacation or when our schedules are interrupted. We must be careful to realize we carry the LORD’s presence with us wherever we go. Therefore, we keep our relationship with God “portable” and always with us.
2027-05-08.application: For a solid week, have your quiet time with God in a new place. Let it be a reminder that the location doesn’t matter; intentional fellowship is what we are after.
2027-05-08.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us through every area of life.

2027-05-09.title: The Light of God’s Word is Always Shining
2027-05-09.verse: You are to command the Israelites that they bring to you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, so that the lamps will burn regularly. In the tent of meeting outside the curtain that is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons are to arrange it from evening to morning before the Lord. This is to be a lasting ordinance among the Israelites for generations to come.
2027-05-09.observation: God told the priests to always keep the candles burning in the holy place. Many people have equated various pieces of furniture in the Tabernacle to certain aspects of the Lord and the various ways we fellowship with Him. One of the ways to see the golden lampstand that was kept burning in the holy place is the Spirit of God and the Word of God. The symbolism is powerful. We must always allow the Holy Spirit to illuminate the Word of God within our hearts. God’s Word talks about meditating on His Word and even uses the illustration of saying we should bind the Words of God to our hands and forehead. The point is to always have it in our heads and in our minds. When we constantly focus on the Lord, we remember His goodness. We remember He is for us and moving in ways we do not always see. He restores our mind and keeps away the fears of life. We must always keep God’s Word close and shining in our lives.
2027-05-09.application: When do you spend time reflecting on God’s Word during your day?
2027-05-09.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for speaking to us every day through Your Word.

2027-05-10.title: You Are On God’s Heart
2027-05-10.verse: Aaron will bear the names of the sons of Israel in the breastpiece of decision over his heart when he goes into the Holy Place, for a memorial before the Lord continually.
2027-05-10.observation: In today’s chapter, we see how the High Priest was to look when performing his duties. The most powerful aspect of this for Christians is that the book of Hebrews in the New Testament calls Jesus our High Priest. We can see many wonderful spiritual parallels between what Aaron was wearing and what Christ has done for us. Perhaps the most striking is when God tells Aaron to wear a symbol of the people over his heart when he goes into the Holy Place. It is to be a continual reminder as to why he is there. He is there to represent the people to God. He was to continually remember the people. This is what Jesus has done for us. His death, burial, and resurrection were for all of us. He had us on His heart when He did these things and continually has us close to His mind. We serve an amazing Savior who loves us more than we can imagine.
2027-05-10.application: How does it change your day to realize you are always close to the heart of God?
2027-05-10.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us the way You do.

2027-05-11.title: God is Not Ashamed of You
2027-05-11.verse: I will reside among the Israelites, and I will be their God, and they will know that I am the Lord their God, who brought them out from the land of Egypt, so that I may reside among them. I am the Lord their God.
2027-05-11.observation: Over the years, I have known people who did not mind being friends with other people. However, they had to be careful who knew about it. There was a fear that their reputation could be affected by associating with someone who was not part of their social circle. The Hebrew people had been liberated from slavery. I think it’s fair to say, they probably did not look like a mighty army moving through the desert. However, the Bible says in today’s passage that one of the reasons for the Tabernacle was for the people to see God as among them. He wanted to be their God. He was not ashamed to be associated with them. Throughout the rest of the Bible, we can see how God is often unhappy with the deeds of His people, but He always still desires to be their God and be close to them. This is a great comfort for us today. Many times, the Lord will be unhappy with what we do, but never with who we are. He loves us and wants to have a relationship with us.
2027-05-11.application: Have you ever thought about the fact that God is not ashamed to be known by you?
2027-05-11.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us and walking with us through our ups and our downs.

2027-05-12.title: The Various Blessings of Giving
2027-05-12.verse: You are to receive the atonement money from the Israelites and give it for the service of the tent of meeting. It will be a memorial for the Israelites before the Lord, to make atonement for your lives.
2027-05-12.observation: In today’s passage, the LORD instructs the people to give to the tabernacle. In doing so, there are many different benefits that are produced. First, the Bible says those who work in the tabernacle are to “receive” the money. This means those who give must not be forced to do this. They must bring it to the LORD. God is cultivating a generous heart that places obedience to God over finances. The second benefit is that it will be used for the “care of the Tabernacle.” This removes the idea that worshiping God is a spectator or consumeristic event. They have a role to play in the worship of God and the care of the things of God. The next benefit is that it will “bring the Israelites to the Lord’s attention.” God always sees us and is mindful of us. The benefit here is that the nation of Israel is reminded of this fact. The final benefit is that it will “purify your lives.” There is almost nothing that fights for the throne of our heart quite like our money. This is because we try to get from money what only God can provide. Therefore, when we submit these desires to the Lord, it purifies our hearts like nothing else can.
2027-05-12.application: Do you struggle to give to the work of God by giving to the local church community you attend? Why? Do you see how God is doing multiple things when we give? How will you take a step in this situation?
2027-05-12.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for working on every area of our heart and life.

2027-05-13.title: God Commands Active Rest
2027-05-13.verse: Tell the Israelites, ‘Surely you must keep my Sabbaths, for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am the Lord who sanctifies you.
2027-05-13.observation: Active rest is a term to describe what professional athletes are supposed to do on their “rest” days. They are supposed to allow their bodies to rest from the normal activities their sport requires and engage in other pursuits that bring rest and rejuvenation to their mind. For professional basketball players, this could be golf. For professional football players, it could be hiking. The point is not to sit around and do nothing, but to give your mind and body a break from the normal patterns. This is the same idea of Sabbath. The Sabbath was given to the people so they would cease from their labor and engage in their relationship with God. It was a sign of trust. They trusted that God would watch over their efforts while they fellowshipped with Him. The same is true today. God commands that we take time out each week and dedicate that time to trusting Him. We spend time in His presence, engaging our lives in our pursuit of Him, and trust that He is working on everything else. Try it and watch what happens.
2027-05-13.application: How will you implement this spiritual discipline this week?
2027-05-13.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for wanting to fellowship with us.

2027-05-14.title: Watch Your Back With Sin
2027-05-14.verse: And the Lord sent a plague on the people because they had made the calf—the one Aaron made.
2027-05-14.observation: Many people have criticized the Hebrews for turning away from God so quickly. It is possible to also give Aaron a hard time for allowing them to do so. However, it is important to realize they had heard of the calf-god Baal their entire lives, and they had likely heard of his “power” over and over. Even though they had witnessed the amazing power of Yahweh, they were still conditioned in ways they had not yet broken free from. When we turn to God, we must be careful about our past sins and old ways of living. Until we become more mature in our walk with God, sin will often try to entice and confuse us. We can forget the slavery of Egypt and only see the momentary peace it offers. Be careful not to let sin lie to you. The moment of pleasure it offers comes with lifelong chains. However, patient faithfulness with Yahweh brings joy that lasts for all eternity.
2027-05-14.application: Is there an old sin constantly whispering to you? Remind yourself that it comes with chains and wait for the LORD.
2027-05-14.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking us out of every dark place and being worth the wait.

2027-05-16.title: Spending Time with the LORD
2027-05-16.verse: The Lord would speak to Moses face to face, the way a person speaks to a friend. Then Moses would return to the camp, but his servant, Joshua son of Nun, a young man, did not leave the tent.
2027-05-16.observation: Moses would separate himself from the people and meet with God. When he did, God would spend time with him as someone spends time with a friend. There is no indicator that God only wanted to do this with Moses. Because of Jesus, we can now walk with the LORD just like Moses. This is a great picture of what our devotional time with the LORD can be like. We find a place and time that is only for the LORD. It doesn’t matter how long it is. What matters is that it is for Him. Then, we speak with God as one speaks with a friend. The best part is we don’t have to leave God there. He continues to walk with us throughout the day.
2027-05-16.application: Do you have a special time set aside where you spend one-on-one time with the LORD? This can be difficult due to your season of life or current living situation. Even if it is a time of silence among others, is there a set aside time you can give to the LORD? If so, do it and watch what starts to happen.
2027-05-16.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for desiring to have fellowship with us.

2027-05-17.title: Do You Have An Afterglow?
2027-05-17.verse: But when Moses went in before the Lord to speak with him, he would remove the veil until he came out. Then he would come out and tell the Israelites what he had been commanded. When the Israelites would see the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone, Moses would put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with the Lord.
2027-05-17.observation: Have you ever looked at the sun too long? When you look away and start blinking, you see an afterglow of the effects of the sun. It changes how you see everything else for a few moments. What happens when people look at you and your life? Does it change how they see everything else for a couple of moments? Does it make them hunger to be more like Christ? Does it bring them the calm peace you are experiencing in Christ? We do not live to impress people. The goal is not to appear to be something more than we are. The goal is to be so changed by Christ and be in such fellowship with Him, that the overflow of our relationship with God shines out for others to see.
2027-05-17.application: Do you live for God in every area of your life? If not, what course corrections do you need to make?
2027-05-17.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for desiring to shine Your light through us.

2027-05-18.title: The Lord Has Gifted You
2027-05-18.verse: He has filled them with skill to do all kinds of work as craftsmen, as designers, as embroiderers in blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and in fine linen, and as weavers. They are craftsmen in all the work and artistic designers.
2027-05-18.observation: In today’s passage, we see that God had given specific gifts to Oholiab for constructing the holy objects. This sounds like a specific set of skills that would not make him good at many other jobs. However, he had been given a group of skills that made him suited for this particular task. The Lord does the same for us. He gives us a specific set of skills that make us good at some things and not good at others. This does not mean we cannot do many different things. It simply means God has gifted us to do certain things. We are not an accident. We are not “unqualified.” The skills may be raw and untrained, but they are there. Only the Lord knows what that purpose is and what type of training we need to do His will. Therefore, never think of a day wasted or a training unneeded. It is all part of God’s plan.
2027-05-18.application: How can you apply yourself today so you’ll be prepared for what the LORD has for you tomorrow?
2027-05-18.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us a purpose.

2027-05-19.title: Excited to Serve the Lord
2027-05-19.verse: Moses summoned Bezalel and Oholiab and every skilled person in whom the Lord had put skill—everyone whose heart stirred him to volunteer to do the work.
2027-05-19.observation: In today’s chapter, the people of God were finally ready to build the place where they would worship. Bezalel and Oholiab were excited to serve in designing the tools for worship. In today’s culture, people are far more likely to be excited about watching other people worship. They come to church to either receive for themselves or to be entertained. These two men were excited to serve the Lord by serving His people. They had realized that it is a greater blessing to serve. Also, we don’t serve people for the sake of the people. We serve people for the sake of the Lord. When He is the object of our affection, it does not matter how people respond. It is all for the LORD.
2027-05-19.application: Where can you serve in your local church community? Look for a way to serve and be excited to serve the Lord by serving His people. It is all for Him.
2027-05-19.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for letting us be a part of Your kingdom.

2027-05-20.title: Skilled For Service
2027-05-20.verse: He made the sacred anointing oil and the pure fragrant incense, the work of a perfumer.
2027-05-20.observation: In today’s chapter, we see how God is continuing to use Bezalel and his team to build the tabernacle and all the instruments of worship. The Bible says that they were skilled in various techniques to make what was needed for worship. Where do you think they learned how to do all these things? It is likely they learned how to do all this while still in slavery. This is a great lesson for all of us. God has given us all gifts, talents, and skills. We learn these skills throughout life in various ways. We should never think that our training is no good if we did not learn it in the house of God. There will be many seasons where God will train us in many ways using various means. The goal is to use these gathered skills and see them as a vehicle to serve the Lord. When we do, we realize that God has gifted all of us and trained all of us to make a difference.
2027-05-20.application: What do you know how to do that you can turn into a vehicle to serve others?
2027-05-20.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for preparing us to make a difference.

2027-05-21.title: Giving for a Higher Purpose
2027-05-21.verse: He made the large basin of bronze and its pedestal of bronze from the mirrors of the women who served at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
2027-05-21.observation: While the Bible does not say directly, it is possible these women had received these mirrors when leaving Egypt. The Bible says that the Egyptians gave many things to them for various reasons as they were leaving. While in slavery, they probably did not have access to mirrors. They had received these “blessings” so that they could be prepared to build God’s House. When we see the blessings of God as something God has given us so that we can bless others, we begin to see how the kingdom of God works. God does not bless us just so that we can sit back and think well of ourselves. He blesses us then gives us the chance to be a blessing to others. Once we realize how wonderful it is to be His hands and feet, we begin to realize the chance to bless others is one of the greatest gifts we have received.
2027-05-21.application: How has God blessed you and positioned you to be a blessing to others?
2027-05-21.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for the chance to be a blessing to others.

2027-05-22.title: You Are On God’s Heart At All Times
2027-05-22.verse: He put them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as stones of memorial for the Israelites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
2027-05-22.observation: In this chapter, we see that the stones placed over the chest of the high priest were to be a reminder of his purpose. He was there as a representative of the people of God before God. The stones along with the weight over his shoulders would remind the high priest of his role and keep the people of God on his mind. The high priest was a forerunner of what Jesus would eventually become. The book of Hebrews says Jesus is our true High Priest. Therefore, the stones remind us that Jesus was our representative and took our place before the judgment seat of God. This is a beautiful picture because He was also the Judge. He knew the penalty and realized what our sin would cost. He took on our sin and made a way for us to enter into the Holy of holies through His sacrifice. Jesus is our true High Priest. This text reminds us of what Jesus did for us because He loves us. We are always on His mind.
2027-05-22.application: You are never alone. You are never forgotten. God is always mindful of you.
2027-05-22.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us the way You do.

2027-05-23.title: The Lord Goes With You
2027-05-23.verse: For the cloud of the Lord was on the tabernacle by day, but fire would be on it at night, in plain view of all the house of Israel throughout all their journeys.
2027-05-23.observation: The journey through the wilderness was not easy. There were possibly a couple million Israelites and they all needed food, clothing, shelter, and direction. They also struggled to honor the Lord. We see constant issues arising and Moses gets so mad he sins against God. This sin keeps him from entering the Promised Land. However, despite all this, the Bible says that God continued to be with them throughout their journeys. In our journeys of life, we will go through good and bad times. We will have ups and downs. There will be seasons when we will feel we are on the right road and other seasons when we are certain we are lost. However, through it all, the Lord never leaves us. He is not a friend who is only around when things are good. He’s the best kind of friend who draws even closer during difficult times.
2027-05-23.application: Take a moment and think of some of your most difficult seasons. Realize the Lord was there working behind the scenes to keep you and walk with you through it.
2027-05-23.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being our constant companion.

2027-05-24.title: Follow Me
2027-05-24.verse: Jesus said to them, “Follow me, and I will turn you into fishers of people!
2027-05-24.observation: Jesus calls us all to be a part of His Kingdom. We all have a place and a chance to do something for Him.
2027-05-24.application: Never think that I cannot make a difference for Him. What can I do today?
2027-05-24.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for counting us worthy of the opportunities You give.

2027-05-25.title: Faith For Others
2027-05-25.verse: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven.
2027-05-25.observation: Can you imagine how embarrassing it was to be lowered down in front of everyone? Then, how much he probably didn't care once he was healed. Great things take great courage and trust in God.
2027-05-25.application: What would I do for God if I had the courage to trust Him?
2027-05-25.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for dealing with our heart issues and healing us so we can be bold.

2027-05-26.title: Family of God
2027-05-26.verse: For whoever does the will of God is my brother and sister and mother.
2027-05-26.observation: God calls us to be in His family. This is such an awesome thing. I love that He says we can be born again, not just do better.
2027-05-26.application: How would I live today if I realized I was in the family of God and was counted as His child?
2027-05-26.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for all You have done for us. We are so thankful to be counted as Yours.

2027-05-27.title: Peace In Storms
2027-05-27.verse: So he got up and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Be quiet! Calm down!” Then the wind stopped, and it was dead calm.
2027-05-27.observation: It is crazy to me to think that God can calm literal storms, but we do not always think God can calm the storms in our lives. We have trouble equating the two because our storm seems too big. However, I am sure this storm seemed like the end for those in the middle of it. If God can do that, what can He do in our lives?
2027-05-27.application: How can I trust God more with my storms?
2027-05-27.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being in the middle of the storm with us.

2027-05-28.title: Do Not Fear
2027-05-28.verse: But Jesus, paying no attention to what was said, told the synagogue leader, “Do not be afraid; just believe.
2027-05-28.observation: This phrase by Jesus always makes me smile. Mainly because I think it sounds so hard to do, but Jesus asks for it anyway. Have you ever tried not to be afraid of something when you're in the middle of it? It's freakin' hard. lol. However, Jesus often asks us to do hard things while He does impossible things.
2027-05-28.application: Today, I'm going to look at every fear and smile. The King is moving.
2027-05-28.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being bigger than our biggest fears.

2027-05-29.title: Trust the Lord
2027-05-29.verse: for they all saw him and were terrified. But immediately he spoke to them: “Have courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.
2027-05-29.observation: Jesus was right in the middle of their darkest moment. People died at sea all the time. Being a fisherman was not an easy job. They likely had known people who died at sea, and they might have thought it was their turn. Nope. Jesus was willing to change the laws of nature to get to His people.
2027-05-29.application: Trust the Lord. Even when it looks impossible, Jesus can change it.
2027-05-29.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for letting nothing stop You from getting to us.

2027-05-31.title: All Things Well
2027-05-31.verse: People were completely astounded and said, “He has done everything well. He even makes the deaf hear and the mute speak.
2027-05-31.observation: God is a King of excellence. He does nothing halfway. He doesn't miss anything. That means if something is incomplete, He is not done.
2027-05-31.application: Trust the Lord with all the little things.
2027-05-31.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for doing all things well in our lives.
